sources.observation: Cantilevered warm concrete bands alternate with dark ribbon glazing on the high-rise. The roof disk overhangs the shaft. The theater has a rust-colored folded conical roof above a raised gallery, and the podium has alternating horizontal slabs and recessed glazing.

limitations: The roof deck fit-out, decorative panels, glazing subdivisions and podium ramps are estimated from public photographs.
